_comment: topl.c addtopl() (198) and wintty.c tty_askname() (670-682): the rc name "games" is generic, so it is asked at start-up and again by role_init()'s plnamesuffix() (role.c:1988). Answer `a` to the pick-for-you prompt in between: show_topl()'s addtopl() calls tty_curs(BASE_WINDOW, 1, 0), which moves the base window to row 0, so the second "Who are you?" is written on row 1 under the answered prompt, not below the banner.
